> 第15章 分享神晶（第1页）
众人到了二楼，发现豪华船票就是不一样，每个独立包房可以容纳二十多人，里面各自都有独立的桌椅，很是宽敞舒适，能看到外面的宽阔的江景。郑风这才知道自己按康庄和大竹林评估的，这条大河原来是神界本地人称作的一条江。
郑风想起康庄，不由想起了在康庄附近乱葬岗被自己救下的少年。发现少年此时由沐沐大哥背着的。
郑风知道一路上众人的消耗很大，都不想因为自己拉整个队伍的后腿，所以每人都是奋力奔走。好在景儿动用了一颗能量珠加持阵盘，虽然只用去了一颗能量珠的三分之一，但景儿事后也心痛不已。
因为到了神界，一切都是未知。因有了拿不出二十多颗下等神晶被众人嘲讽的遭遇，景儿愈发珍惜为数不多的修行资源。
郑风给每人三颗下等神晶，“大伙都吸收神晶恢复一下，我们要慢慢适应新环境的修行方式。”
众人都觉得太奢侈，刚才还为一颗下等神晶购票发愁，现在郑风让每人用三颗下等神晶修炼。
郑风随后拿出一枚储物戒递给青鱼，众人更好奇了。
“青鱼，这个储物戒指里有几百颗中等神晶，还有一些修炼资源，你就负责管理天团少年修炼资源的开销。”郑风说得淡然，觉得大伙该提升了，有了神晶和众人分享是件很正常的事情。
青鱼接过储物戒，手都在颤抖，天团少年听得几百颗中品神晶脸都红了，这次不是羞红了，是兴奋的。由一个一文不名的穷小子，一下子变得富有的感觉，那份喜悦可想而知。
“古风大哥这枚戒指里也有几百枚中品神晶，你就负责管理前辈们修行资源的开销。”古风没想到郑风把如此重要的修炼资源交给自己保管。他们都是老江湖，早就在售票处打听了神晶的行情。
一枚中品神晶可以换一百枚下等神晶，一枚下等神晶可以换百枚普通晶石，一枚普通晶石寻常人可以吃几顿饭。神界普通人都用晶石作为货币，武君以上修为的通用货币才是神晶。
古风心里感叹自己跟随郑风来神界没错，若自己独自前来，一张船票就要让自己难堪，虽然也许和郑杰一样会找到其他办法解决，但终究十分麻烦。
所有的人心里都踏实了，至少不用担心饿饭。短时间内不用担心举步维艰。大家开始吸收神晶恢复实力。
郑风偷偷给景儿一个储物戒，景儿很自然的就收下了。郑风还给了一个储物戒给师祖云剑尊，云剑尊心领神会，也淡然地收好。
郑风这下才打量起手中的神晶，下等神晶比中等神晶小很多，大概是中品神晶体积的十分之一，明显神晶价值不是按体积算的，百枚下等神晶才换一枚中品神晶。
郑风之前一下子吸收了几百枚中品神晶，现在再来感受一两枚下等神晶，发现蕴含的神力十分微弱，提不起丝毫兴趣，不屑一顾，干脆留了下来，以备不时之需。
想到就这不屑一顾的下等神晶能买一张船票，这个黑乎乎的丑东西，在神界也是有点用处的。丑不丑不重要，关键是大家认可他的交换功能，不由一阵唏嘘，没有神晶真是寸步难行！
大伙只用了一颗下等神晶的三分之一恢复实力，感觉差不多了就留了下来。都体验了没有神晶寸步难行的尴尬，知道一颗下等神晶可换神界普通人手中的百枚晶石，几百顿饭，还是节约点过吧！

郑风看了看大伙肉疼的表情，知道大伙舍不得。
“其实我只有记得师祖说的话，机会是拿来用的，只要用在刀口上，都是值得的，修炼资源也是如此。”

The latest chapter of Tianwu God Zun_Chapter 15 Sharing the Divine Crystal Page 1_Tianwu God Zun Feng Ge_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 15 Sharing the Divine Crystal (Page 1)
When everyone arrived on the second floor, they found that the luxury boat ticket was different. Each independent private room could accommodate more than twenty people. Each room had its own table and chairs. It was very spacious and comfortable, with a wide view of the river outside. Only then did Zheng Feng realize that the river he had evaluated based on Kangzhuang and Dazhulin turned out to be a river that the locals in the God Realm called.
Zheng Feng thought of Kangzhuang and couldn't help but think of the young man he rescued from the mass grave near Kangzhuang. It was discovered that the boy was being carried by Brother Mumu.
Zheng Feng knew that everyone was spending a lot of energy along the way, and he didn't want to hold back the entire team because of himself, so everyone ran hard. Fortunately, Jing'er used an energy bead to support the array. Although only one-third of the energy bead was used, Jing'er was heartbroken afterwards.
Because in the God Realm, everything is unknown. Because of the experience of being ridiculed by everyone for not being able to produce more than twenty inferior divine crystals, Jing'er cherished the few cultivation resources even more.
Zheng Feng gave each person three inferior divine crystals, "Everyone, please absorb the divine crystals to recover. We must slowly adapt to the new environment and practice."
Everyone felt it was too extravagant. Just now they were worried about buying tickets for one low-grade divine crystal. Now Zheng Feng asked everyone to practice with three low-grade divine crystals.
Zheng Feng then took out a storage ring and handed it to Qingyu, making everyone even more curious.
"Qingyu, there are hundreds of medium-level divine crystals in this storage ring, as well as some cultivation resources. You will be responsible for managing the expenses of the Tiantuan youth's cultivation resources." Zheng Feng said calmly, thinking that everyone should improve. It is normal to have divine crystals and share them with everyone.
Qingyu took the storage ring, his hands trembling, and the Tiantuan boy blushed when he heard the hundreds of middle-grade divine crystals. This time, he was not blushing, but excited. You can imagine the joy that comes from being a poor boy with no money and suddenly becoming rich.
"Brother Gu Feng, this ring also contains hundreds of mid-grade divine crystals. You will be responsible for managing the expenses of the seniors' cultivation resources." Gu Feng did not expect Zheng Feng to entrust such important cultivation resources to himself for safekeeping. They were all veterans and had already inquired about the market situation of Shenjing at the ticket office.
One medium-grade divine crystal can be exchanged for one hundred low-grade divine crystals, one low-grade divine crystal can be exchanged for one hundred ordinary crystals, and one ordinary crystal can feed an ordinary person several meals. Ordinary people in the God Realm use crystal stones as currency, and the common currency for those who are above the level of Wujun is divine crystal.
Gu Feng sighed in his heart that he was right to follow Zheng Feng to the God Realm. If he came alone, a ticket would embarrass him. Although he might find other solutions like Zheng Jie, it would be very troublesome after all.
Everyone felt at ease, at least they didn't have to worry about being hungry. Don’t worry about struggling in the short term. Everyone began to absorb the divine crystals to regain their strength.
Zheng Feng secretly gave Jing'er a storage ring, and Jing'er accepted it naturally. Zheng Feng also gave a storage ring to his master Yunjianzun. Yunjianzun understood it and put it away calmly.
Only then did Zheng Feng look at the divine crystal in his hand. The low-grade divine crystal was much smaller than the medium-grade divine crystal. It was about one-tenth the volume of the middle-grade divine crystal. Obviously the value of the divine crystal was not calculated by volume. It took one hundred low-grade divine crystals to exchange for one medium-grade divine crystal.
Zheng Feng had absorbed hundreds of mid-grade divine crystals before, and now he felt one or two low-grade divine crystals. He found that the divine power contained was very weak, and he couldn't arouse the slightest interest. He dismissed them and simply kept them for emergencies.
Thinking that this low-level divine crystal with such disdain can buy a boat ticket, this dark and ugly thing has some use in the divine world. It doesn't matter whether he is ugly or not, the key is that everyone recognizes his exchange function. He couldn't help but sigh, it is really difficult to move forward without the divine crystal!
Everyone only used one-third of a low-level divine crystal to restore their strength. It feels likeIt was almost done so I stayed. We have all experienced the embarrassment of being unable to move without a divine crystal. Knowing that one low-grade divine crystal can be exchanged for hundreds of crystals and hundreds of meals in the hands of ordinary people in the divine world, it is better to save money!
Zheng Feng looked at everyone's painful expressions and knew that everyone was reluctant to let go.
"Actually, I only remember what my master said. Opportunities are for use. As long as they are used on the edge of the knife, they are all worth it. The same goes for cultivation resources."
